name: tachoparser
description:
tachoparser is an open-source application designed to read, inspect, and analyze digital tachograph driver cards and vehicle unit (.DDD / .TGD / .V1B) data files for transport compliance.

Features:
- Parses digital driver card files (.DDD) and vehicle unit data according to EU regulations
- Visualizes driving hours, rest breaks, daily work shifts, and weekly driving activity
- Identifies potential driving time infringements and regulation compliance issues
- Generates clear visual timelines and activity reports for transport managers
- Works completely locally ensuring confidential driver data remains private
